about: Golden set for the quote extractor (ARCHITECTURE §8.2, PROMPTS Phase 5 item 8). Run with `pnpm eval:extract` (calls OpenAI with OPENAI_API_KEY, DECISIONS R19; target ≥ 9/10). The persona cases are the simulator's own transcripts for the demo order (fictional dealers, made-up prices); the handwritten ones are a per-quintal quote with GST unclear and a dealer who corrects his own number. `expected` is what the dealer said, in lib/extraction.ts's Extraction shape (confidence isn't scored). Haggle cases carry the dealer's earlier terms; haggle and match cases carry the cited total in rupees. Real call transcripts, with names and numbers replaced, are added later.
